### Milestone 1: MVP (End of Phase 5)
- Authentication
- Basic writing (chapters)
- Basic worldbuilding (characters, locations)
- Word export

### Milestone 2: Feature Complete (End of Phase 6)
- All core features implemented
- Spell checking
- Tagging
- Ebook export

### Milestone 3: Production Ready (End of Phase 8)
- Fully tested
- Optimized
- Deployed
- Documented

## Risk Management

### Technical Risks
- **Risk**: Complex document generation
  - **Mitigation**: Use proven libraries, start with simple formats
- **Risk**: Object database performance
  - **Mitigation**: Proper indexing, caching strategy
- **Risk**: Spell check API costs
  - **Mitigation**: Rate limiting, caching, consider self-hosted solution

### Timeline Risks
- **Risk**: Feature scope creep
  - **Mitigation**: Strict prioritization, MVP focus
- **Risk**: Integration complexity
  - **Mitigation**: Early integration testing, proof of concepts
